blocks.title: IHG One Rewards
blocks.body: Hotel Indigo participates in IHG One Rewards. Members earn and redeem points and receive Elite recognition across participating sister brands. Confirm current tier names and earn rules on the official program site before IC.

blocks.title: Loyalty
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards at Hotel Indigo

blocks.title: Earn
blocks.body: Guests earn IHG One Rewards points on qualifying stays at Hotel Indigo. Elite members may receive enhanced earn and recognition benefits per current program rules.

blocks.title: Redeem
blocks.body: Points redeem for stays across the IHG One Rewards portfolio, including Hotel Indigo, subject to availability and current redemption charts.

blocks.title: Elite Recognition
blocks.body: Elite status recognition (upgrades, late checkout, lounge access where offered) applies per property capability—delivery varies by hotel.

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards partnerships, co-branded cards, and bonus campaigns expand the loyalty halo; Hotel Indigo stays remain the property-level earn/redeem node.

blocks.title: Owner Lens
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards drives distribution and repeat demand but adds loyalty chargebacks and program economics. Underwrite net contribution after loyalty—not membership vanity metrics.

blocks.title: P&L Implications
blocks.body: Loyalty assessments and program contribution affect net rooms revenue. Use current agreement exhibits; do not invent undisclosed rates.

blocks.title: Operating Implications
blocks.body: Front desk and systems must support IHG One Rewards enrollment, Elite recognition, and redemption stays without erasing the brand's guest experience.

blocks.title: Systems Implications
blocks.body: Parent property and reservation systems integration is required for IHG One Rewards participation—budget cutover and training in the conversion plan.

blocks.title: Repeat Guest Capture
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards earn and recognition support repeat Hotel Indigo stays when the hotel already delivers the brand promise—membership alone does not replace product fit.

blocks.title: Direct Channel & Member Pricing
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards member rates and IHG direct paths help Hotel Indigo defend contribution versus high-commission intermediaries; confirm current rate rules before IC.

blocks.title: Elite Member Value
blocks.body: Elite recognition benefits support contribution at Hotel Indigo where the property can deliver upgrades and service standards; capability still varies by asset.

blocks.title: Cross-Brand Traveler Flow
blocks.body: One Rewards recognition across IHG sister brands matters for multi-brand itineraries—Hotel Indigo is the brand-specific earn/redeem node inside that network.

blocks.title: Partner & Payment Scale
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards partnerships and bonus campaigns expand acquisition; underwrite hotel-level net contribution after loyalty assessments—not headline membership counts.

blocks.title: Corporate & Negotiated Demand
blocks.body: IHG account and negotiated transient patterns can support midweek compression where corporate mix fits Hotel Indigo—validate against this hotel's source markets.

blocks.title: To Join
blocks.body: Hotel Indigo application, royalty, program fees, and One Rewards assessments — confirm current IHG disclosure exhibits. Amounts are not staged without a verified disclosure.

blocks.title: To Operate
blocks.body: Steady-state royalty, program contribution, and IHG One Rewards loyalty assessments — confirm definitions, bases, and current percentages in the live disclosure exhibit for Hotel Indigo. Do not underwrite from peer rumor.

blocks.title: When Things Change
blocks.body: Renewal PIP; conversion PIP revisions; transfer / change-of-ownership fees; termination-related obligations; owner-funded reserves—triggered at renewal, repositioning, or exit. Confirm liquidated damages and transfer mechanics in the current agreement.

blocks.title: Fee Variability
blocks.body: Initial vs conversion paths differ; program contribution and loyalty assessments may change by year under agreement terms. Lock the fee exhibit before IC—never extrapolate from a peer hotel's rumor. Geography note: Confirm current IHG development / franchise disclosure for Hotel Indigo

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add IHG One Rewards: retain Hotel Indigo's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Neighborhood boutique: local design cues, neighborhood storytelling, and upscale-lifestyle stays with IHG One Rewards distribution.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.

blocks.title: Neighborhood Boutique Urban
blocks.body: Walkable neighborhoods where local design, F&B, and place narrative can lift boutique rates with IHG One Rewards behind the stay.

blocks.title: Adaptive Reuse Neighborhood Story
blocks.body: Conversions that can express neighborhood character—underwrite design PIP and local storytelling so the Indigo promise is visible in product.

blocks.title: Leisure-Led Destination Weekends
blocks.body: Markets where weekend leisure and local discovery drive mix—pair One Rewards midweek accounts with neighborhood leisure programming.
